about: Tests whose input is the checked-in tree itself (#2681). Each entry splits into rule files (the test, the code or tool that does the walk, and any expected-set file) and the scope the walk reads. Two branches that touch disjoint files still break when one changes a rule file and the other changes a path in that entry's scope (#2642 + #2632). `moai-cli repo-scans` judges a pull request against the tip with this table (#2708; formerly tools/repo_scans.py); tests/repo_scans_table.rs keeps the table complete.

scans.rejects: CLONE_STATE_DIR used outside src/lib.rs and src/clone_root.rs instead of clone_root::{dir, path} (#2696 C4c)
a top-level HOME state name written in src/ (home_root::path or state_root::path with a literal first name) that is not in home_layout::HOME_TABLE (#2871 D-M1)
HOME_STATE_DIR used outside src/lib.rs, src/home_root.rs and the pinned files instead of home_root::{dir, path} (#2696 C4b)
a ".moai-cli" path spelled as a string literal outside src/lib.rs instead of project_state!/fixed_state! (#2725 S1)

a source file outside the pending list whose code (comments and the test module left out) carries a card number, an Issue or pull-request number, a decision citation or a moai-adk development script name (SPEC-20261120-cli-text-citations)
a copy of the permission-reference rule outside src/contract.rs (#2642 + #2632)
the ledger file name spelled in src/ outside src/ledger/location.rs instead of ledger::location::ledger_path (#3068 P1)

a ledger test that runs the binary without TempHome, a test that runs the binary without naming HOME and is not in the baseline list, or a process, socket, program name or URL in src/ledger/ (#3068 P2)
